from donations import load_donations, ROWS
from pool import DonationPool


def test_total_after_remove():
    rows = list(load_donations())
    pool = DonationPool()
    for x in rows:
        pool.add(x)
    full = pool.total()
    pool.remove(rows[0])
    assert pool.total() == full - ROWS[0][1]


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_donations())
    pool = DonationPool()
    pool.add(rows[0])
    pool.total()
    pool.add(rows[1])
    assert pool.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]
